baseline_profile_prep.compile_policy: clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror; separate translation units; no LTO
baseline_profile_prep.environment_policy: CC=clang; all GC_* cleared; profiling invocation will pin GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR=1; nursery=262136 bytes

compiler_consequence: Assembly inspection: scan_promote became out of line in both variants.
counter_equality: Whole-inline and fast-split deterministic custom JSON fields match baseline exactly in every matched profile/capacity/repetition. Excluded only elapsed_seconds, preparation_seconds, process_peak_rss_bytes and three tree phase duration fields.

matrix_manifest.checks: return codes, allocation counts, checksum, custom allocation/payload/live/pool/accounting identities; source and binary hashes reverified after final row
matrix_manifest.compile_flags: custom clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror, USE_PREPARED INLINE_ALLOC INLINE_STORE; Boehm arms static libgc.a; no LTO
matrix_manifest.custom_counter_comparison: all deterministic result keys exact versus baseline for whole_inline and fast_split; only elapsed/preparation/RSS/tree phase times excluded
matrix_manifest.order_policy: Each profile/cap/round executes all five arms sequentially; order rotates left by round index. Eight rounds produce balanced near-uniform placement; exact command order is retained per row.
matrix_manifest.setup_and_timing: fresh process per row; descriptor prep occurs outside workload elapsed_seconds; three phase clock reads only for tree construction end, checksum end, and final-major start; no per-allocation clock instrumentation

outcome: Both variants preserve all deterministic custom counters but show no consistent, useful timing win; cache matrix remains separately preserved.

source_provenance.build_policy: clang -std=c11 -O2 -g -Wall -Wextra -Werror; separate translation units; no LTO
source_provenance.compiler_consequence: Assembly inspection reports scan_promote became out of line in both fast-path variants.
source_provenance.counter_policy: Whole-inline and fast-split custom deterministic result fields exactly match baseline; only elapsed/preparation/RSS/tree-phase clocks are excluded.

matrix_policy.environment: all GC_* cleared; GC_FREE_SPACE_DIVISOR=1; GC_INITIAL_HEAP_SIZE unset

workload_phase.instrumentation: three added clock reads for tree construction end, checksum end, and final major start; no per-allocation timing; same workload for every arm

timing_interpretation: Each cell reports min/median/max across eight fresh processes per arm. Boehm winner is the lower numeric median among both Boehm arms separately for each profile and capacity. Timing includes workload and final collection; tree phase clocks isolate construction, checksum traversal, and final major plus cleanup, with three added clock reads per tree process and no per-allocation clocks.
